verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents its own transactions endpoints for retrieving transactions by card, merchant, and account holder, and webhooks that report API events as they occur. Together these give a real-time view of transaction activity, but the pack never shows the rest of the finance-lead story. Balance inquiries appear only as a sandbox simulation type. Missing for 10: a documented account/card balance retrieval endpoint, a ledger linking each authorization to its clearing record, settlement/reconciliation reporting, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see money move in real time — account and card balances, a transaction ledger that ties every authorization to its clearing, and settlement reporting that reconciles to the penny

citations.quote: You can also retrieve transactions associated with specific cards, merchants, and account holders using the endpoints described here.
Webhooks are notifications about API events, sent as they occur.
Transaction intelligence: Query, analyze, and monitor payment activity through natural language interactions.
